blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tripura's economic development relies on both dedicated State Government Schemes and impactful Central Schemes.
Road and transport infrastructure form the primary backbone for internal connectivity in the state.
The Agartala–Akhaura Rail Link is a landmark cross-border project providing historic connectivity.
Air transport and targeted major infrastructure projects serve as key drivers for regional mobility and economic growth.

blocks.content: 12.2 Central Schemes with Major Impact in Tripura

items: PMGSY (Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana): Major road construction; connected remote tribal villages
PM Awas Yojana (Rural): Housing; Tripura has achieved high implementation rate
Jal Jeevan Mission: Piped water to all households; good progress in Tripura
PM KISAN: Rs 6,000/year to farmers; widely availed
Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT): Agartala included; water supply, drainage
Smart Cities Mission: Agartala selected as Smart City; urban infrastructure
National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM): Self-help groups; women's empowerment; Tripura has strong SHG network
Aspirational Districts: Dhalai was an aspirational district; received special funding and attention

blocks.content: The Agartala–Akhaura Rail Link is one of the most significant infrastructure achievements in Tripura's history. This 15 km rail link connects Agartala (India) with Akhaura (Bangladesh), providing Tripura a direct rail connection to the rest of India via Bangladesh.

items: Inauguration: November 1, 2023 — jointly inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi (India) and PM Sheikh Hasina (Bangladesh) via video conference
Route: Agartala → Nischintapur (India) → Akhaura (Bangladesh) → Bangladesh rail network → Kolkata
Impact on travel: Agartala to Kolkata via Bangladesh = approximately 700 km and under 10 hours by train; via Indian territory = 1,650 km and 40+ hours
Economic impact: Massive reduction in freight costs for goods going to and from Tripura
Tourism: Dhaka and other Bangladesh cities now within easy reach
Strategic: Reduces Tripura's dependence on the Siliguri Corridor
The Agartala–Akhaura Rail Link is a high-yield topic for competitive exams regarding international cross-border infrastructure.
